epic.summary: Schema Drift Remediation — Wind River 24.12 / Redfish v1.16.0
epic.description:
Wind River 24.12 introduces Redfish v1.16.0 which contains 3 breaking schema changes against the v1.14.0 baseline currently referenced by the Verizon Far Edge automation catalog. 14 scripts are impacted across 6 playbook categories. This epic tracks remediation for every impacted script before the wave deployment can proceed.

SchemaWatchAgent detection: 2026-01-12 03:18:44 (6 days ahead of the scheduled cycle)
Vendor reference: Wind River 24.12 Release Notes §3.2
Wave deployment status: HELD pending epic completion.

tickets.description:
ROBOT test s1-t1 measured CU-UP P99 interface latency at 8.3ms against the 5ms certification threshold on cu_up_interface_0.

Root-cause hypothesis (CertificationAgent):
  kernel.sched_rt_runtime_us at default 950000. Confirmed cross-reference KB-2026-0118 in the Verizon Known Issues KB. The fix is to set sched_rt_runtime_us=980000 via /etc/sysctl.d/99-rt-tune.conf and reboot.

Recommended action:
  Apply the workaround documented in KB-2026-0118 across all CaaS-Node-Type-B sites in the Northeast region (estimated 252 sites match the impacted profile per ApexSignal). Permanent fix lands in Wind River 25.01.

Generated by APEX CertificationAgent. Do not close without APEX review.

tickets.summary: [P1] Schema drift — PowerState relocated to Status.PowerState (6 playbooks impacted)
tickets.description:
Schema v1.14.0 → v1.16.0 relocated PowerState from /redfish/v1/Systems/1.PowerState to /redfish/v1/Systems/1.Status.PowerState (path migration).

Impacted scripts:
  • power_check.yml
  • node_health_check.yml
  • pre_upgrade_validation.yml
  • post_upgrade_validation.yml
  • site_readiness_check.yml
  • wave_deployment_preflight.yml

Remediation (deterministic find/replace):
  Systems/1.PowerState → Systems/1.Status.PowerState

Effort estimate: 30 min per playbook × 6 playbooks = 3 person-hours.
Vendor release-note reference: Wind River 24.12 §3.2.1.
